name: Decision Criteria Map
purpose: A visual aid to evaluate alternatives to select the best answer.
whereUsed: The Decision Criteria Map is best introduced in the Solution Space during the Alternatives Phase to Determine Value, Costs & Risks of Options. It’s also useful in subsequent phases (Answer, Acceptance, Actions) to communicate and reinforce how a decision (selecting the best answer) was made.
why: We will make a better decision (select the best answer) to alternatives being considered.
outcomes: Understanding of similarities and differences among alternatives
Objective scoring of alternatives to determine the best answer

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “ALTERNATIVES PHASE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Establish the decision criteria to evaluate alternatives
Score potential alternatives based on the decision criteria
Facilitate a candid dialog to capture decision dynamics

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “ANSWER, ACCEPTANCE, OR ACTIONS PHASE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Explain the decision criteria used to evaluate alternatives
Outline all the alternatives that were considered
Recap decision dynamics and scoring for the alternatives
Highlight the rationale for the selected answer
